en.html: ...I struck with the back of my blade. The dragoon took it, gave it no importance whatsoever, and finished the stroke that killed my foster mother.
en.text: ...I struck with the back of my blade. The dragoon took it, gave it no importance whatsoever, and finished the stroke that killed my foster mother.

ja.html:
……俺の、峰打ちを受けた竜騎兵は、
　意にも介さず、養母を殺す一撃を完遂した。
